_directive: losslessly compressed, token-efficient, information-dense, fully detailed, machine-facing; optimized for model parsing over human readability
purpose: Invoked when pipeline needs: (a) document ingestion/chunking decisions (format planning, PDF extraction, layout detection, chunking strategy selection, dedup, provenance capture, serialization); (b) per-chunk dense JSON distillation with schema-constrained decoding, losslessness enforcement, compression ratio targeting; (c) KD theory application (teacher selection, student architecture, distillation loss design, training loop, CoT distillation); (d) deployment of specialist LLMs (routing logic, scope boundary, orchestration latency/cost, Goodhart monitoring, benchmark evaluation).
role: Expert operating spec for the Knowledge Distillation & Dense Representation domain. Covers two subdomains: (1) distill__ingest: document-source planning, multi-format extraction (PDF/DOCX/HTML), layout detection, table/figure handling, fixed/semantic/hierarchical chunking, deduplication, provenance capture, JSONL sharding, chunk quality validation, embedding-readiness gating, incremental ingestion; (2) distill__kb_distill: KD theory (dark knowledge, temperature scaling), teacher selection & license compliance, student architecture sizing, distillation loss (KL divergence + temperature + alpha), distillation data pipeline (logit caching, curriculum), per-chunk dense JSON distillation, JSON schema design, constrained decoding (Outlines/FSM), losslessness enforcement (entity recall, numeric preservation, caveat retention), dense-to-human rendering, schema versioning & migration, specialist scope definition, routing logic, orchestration latency/cost modeling, Goodhart/contamination monitoring.

capabilities.method: Enumerate file types (PDF/DOCX/HTML/TXT), source systems (S3/GCS/SharePoint/web), volume profiles, and access credentials; produce document source manifest and format coverage report
capabilities.when_to_use: At pipeline start when input document corpus is undefined or multi-format; triggers on new data source onboarding or format distribution shift >15%

capabilities.method: Use pdfplumber or PyMuPDF for text+bounding-box extraction; reconstruct reading order for multi-column layouts; apply OCR fallback (Tesseract/PaddleOCR) for scanned pages; normalize ligatures and encodings; flag empty-string outputs with error codes
capabilities.when_to_use: When input documents include PDFs; escalates if OCR error rate spikes or new PDF encoding types appear; WER target <5% on scanned pages

capabilities.method: Classify document elements (heading/paragraph/table/figure/caption/header-footer) via rule-based heuristics or ML models (LayoutLM, PaddleOCR); assign bounding boxes; infer section hierarchy; exclude headers/footers from body text; produce structured element tree
capabilities.when_to_use: After PDF extraction when structure-aware chunking is needed; escalates when element classification F1 <0.85 on held-out fixture or misclassification rate >10%

capabilities.method: Extract cell-level text from detected table regions; detect row/column headers; resolve merged cells; serialize to markdown or structured JSON; flag multi-header and nested-table cases
capabilities.when_to_use: When corpus contains tables with relational data; cell error rate >5% on sample triggers review

capabilities.method: Extract captions from detected figure regions; optionally generate alt-text via vision model (toggleable); track image provenance; apply figure-exclusion policy if caption-only mode
capabilities.when_to_use: When corpus has significant figure density or RAG queries involve visual content; vision alt-text generation toggleable per cost budget

capabilities.method: Choose chunking strategy (fixed-size-with-overlap, sentence-boundary, semantic/cosine-drop, or hierarchical parent-child) based on document type, embedding model context window, and retrieval SLA; configure token budget, overlap fraction, and min/max guardrails
capabilities.when_to_use: Before any chunk implementation; highest-leverage decision for downstream RAG recall/precision; revisit on embedding model swap, recall degradation >5%, or new document length distribution

capabilities.method: Split cleaned text into fixed-token-count chunks with configurable overlap; snap to sentence boundaries where possible; annotate each chunk with doc_id, page, and span metadata; produce chunk manifest JSONL
capabilities.when_to_use: Baseline strategy; use when speed and predictability dominate; lower retrieval quality than semantic but fast and deterministic; context window constraint is hard

capabilities.method: Detect topic/semantic boundaries via cosine-similarity drop in sentence embeddings; segment at detected boundaries; enforce min/max token guardrails to prevent oversized or trivially small chunks; annotate with boundary-score metadata
capabilities.when_to_use: When retrieval quality matters more than speed; best for narrative or scientific text with clear topic shifts; requires embedding model; improves MRR 15-25% over fixed-512 baseline

capabilities.method: Build two-level chunk hierarchy: section-level parent chunks and paragraph-level child chunks; link bidirectionally via parent_id references; retrieval returns child chunk, generation expands to parent context
capabilities.when_to_use: When retrieval needs fine-grained precision but generation needs broader context; long-form documents with clear section structure; depends on LAYOUT_DETECT section hierarchy

capabilities.method: Detect and remove exact and near-duplicate chunks using token Jaccard similarity above configurable threshold; log removed duplicates with provenance; retain one canonical instance per near-duplicate cluster
capabilities.when_to_use: Always run before embedding; boilerplate-heavy corpora (legal, policy docs) require aggressive dedup; Jaccard threshold tunable per corpus

capabilities.method: Annotate each chunk with full lineage: source document id, page range, byte offsets, extraction tool version, chunking strategy, chunk position, and transformation history; serialize as structured JSONL fields
capabilities.when_to_use: Required for every chunk entering the pipeline; enables citation traceability in RAG and audit trail for distillation; kb_node_id links chunk to KB node for structured retrieval

capabilities.method: Apply Hinton/Vinyals/Dean 2015 framework: train student on teacher soft probability outputs (dark knowledge) at temperature T; KL divergence loss weighted alpha for soft targets, (1-alpha) for hard labels; temperature sweep over {1,2,4,8,16} to calibrate gradient informativeness; document compression rationale
capabilities.when_to_use: When designing any student training objective; foundational node—must be resolved before teacher selection, student architecture, or loss design; triggers on teacher architecture change or task label distribution shift

capabilities.method: Evaluate candidate teacher models on: capability ceiling (domain benchmark score >=10pts above student baseline), license/ToS compliance (API distillation restrictions—OpenAI prohibits training competitors), compute cost per token, and domain alignment; fallback to open-weight teacher when API teacher is ToS-restricted
capabilities.when_to_use: Before any distillation run; blocks on unresolved license status; high irreversibility (0.72)—wrong choice requires full pipeline restart

capabilities.method: Size student architecture (parameter count, family) to meet inference latency SLA while achieving within 5% of teacher accuracy on narrow target task; specialist student at 1/10 teacher size can match generalist teacher on narrow domain; choose architecture without exceeding serving budget
capabilities.when_to_use: After teacher selection; revisit when SLA tightens or task scope expands; specialist beats generalist only when task scope is narrow and well-defined

capabilities.method: Implement combined loss: KL_divergence(teacher_softmax(logits/T), student_softmax(logits/T)) * alpha + CrossEntropy(hard_labels) * (1-alpha); optionally add feature/layer matching for intermediate representations; run ablation over temperature and alpha values; document hyperparameter grid
capabilities.when_to_use: Core distillation step; ablation required to confirm soft-target benefit over hard-label baseline; feature distillation adds complexity—use only when architectures are depth-compatible

capabilities.method: Generate and cache teacher soft labels (logits) on training corpus: batch teacher inference, store logits keyed by (sample_id, teacher_checkpoint_hash); apply curriculum ordering; run deduplication (<0.1% duplicate threshold); version cache by teacher checkpoint hash to prevent label mixing
capabilities.when_to_use: After teacher selection and loss design; logit caching amortizes teacher inference cost across multiple student training runs; invalidate cache on teacher version update

capabilities.method: Distill each source text chunk into maximally dense JSON record via LLM: capture entities, relations, numeric facts, caveats/negations, provenance, and structure; eliminate filler/redundancy; apply constrained decoding to guarantee schema-valid output; target compression ratio >=3:1 while maintaining entity recall >=0.95
capabilities.when_to_use: Core pipeline step for every ingested chunk; schema must be finalized before distillation run; triggers re-run on schema version bump or new entity types observed in corpus

capabilities.method: Design JSON Schema 2020-12 compliant schema for dense KB records: define field taxonomy (required/optional split), type constraints, nested object structure, version field; validate with JSON Schema validator; maintain migration guide; avoid coupling schema to single LLM output idiom
capabilities.when_to_use: Before distillation pipeline runs; schema is high-irreversibility decision (0.60)—changes require migration; update triggers: new entity type encountered or schema validator version upgrade

capabilities.method: Apply FSM-based constrained decoding (Outlines library, Willard & Louf 2023) to mask invalid tokens at each generation step using finite-state machine compiled from target JSON schema over tokenizer vocabulary; eliminates post-hoc repair; verify FSM compiles in <30s; confirm parse failure rate = 0% on 1000-record sample
capabilities.when_to_use: Required for all LLM-generated JSON in distillation pipeline; supersedes prompt-only output control; recompile FSM on schema update or tokenizer/model version change

capabilities.method: Measure round-trip fidelity: entity recall via NER comparison (target >=0.95), numeric fact preservation via exact-match (target >=0.99), caveat/negation retention via NLI entailment (target >=0.90); flag lossy records for re-distillation; do not use ROUGE as fidelity proxy
capabilities.when_to_use: After every distillation batch; required gate before production deployment; triggers human review when any fidelity metric falls below threshold

capabilities.method: Build template engine (Jinja2 or equivalent) mapping dense JSON fields to prose sentences; support output format variants (markdown/HTML/plain); render conditionally on optional field presence; verify all required schema fields appear in render; test rendering roundtrip recovers >=90% of fields
capabilities.when_to_use: When downstream consumers need human-readable output from dense KB records; decouples consumer interface from internal JSON schema enabling schema evolution via template update only

capabilities.method: Maintain version field in all JSON records; apply backward-compatibility rules (additive changes only for minor versions); generate migration scripts tested on 1000 production records before deployment; maintain deprecation timeline; document rollback procedure
capabilities.when_to_use: On any schema change; version field required from day one; high irreversibility (0.60)—unversioned schema makes migration impossible at scale

capabilities.method: Extract teacher chain-of-thought reasoning traces when teacher logits are inaccessible (API-only teacher); compress traces into instruction-following demonstrations; human-review 50 sampled CoT traces for correctness before student fine-tuning; target student reasoning accuracy within 5% of teacher on trace-verified test set
capabilities.when_to_use: Fallback when teacher API does not expose logits (e.g., GPT-4 API); introduces hallucination risk from incorrect CoT steps—human review mandatory

capabilities.method: Define narrow task scope where specialist beats generalist (>=10pt benchmark advantage); build out-of-scope detection classifier (precision >=0.90 on boundary test set); configure fallback routing to generalist; monitor scope drift via production query distribution tracking
capabilities.when_to_use: Before deploying any specialist LLM; without explicit scope boundary, specialist degrades silently on out-of-scope traffic; revisit on production query distribution shift

capabilities.method: Implement confidence-thresholded query classifier dispatching to specialist registry; threshold >=0.85 prevents low-confidence specialist misapplication; support ensemble aggregation and generalist fallback; maintain routing audit log with every dispatch decision and confidence score; target fallback rate <15%
capabilities.when_to_use: Required in any multi-specialist orchestration system; confidence threshold tuning required before production; revisit on new specialist addition or query distribution shift

capabilities.method: Model end-to-end latency: parallel calls use max(latency_A, latency_B); serial chains sum latencies plus network overhead; include cold-start latency in SLA projections; project cost-per-query at target QPS; verify p95 latency within SLA on load test
capabilities.when_to_use: When designing multi-specialist routing topology; revisit when new specialist added or SLA tightened; parallel call patterns preferred to hide serial chain overhead

capabilities.method: Maintain private canary benchmark (not published or shared) independent of public benchmarks; run n-gram + embedding similarity contamination scan on training corpus before any benchmark reporting; require human eval correlation >=0.75 (Pearson) with automated benchmark; flag metric-utility divergence when benchmark improves but human eval does not
capabilities.when_to_use: Before every public benchmark report and on training corpus update; required to detect Goodhart gaming and pretraining contamination; contamination scan mandatory—omitting it invalidates reported numbers

capabilities.method: Evaluate distilled student on multi-benchmark suite (reduces Goodhart risk vs single metric); require held-out human eval on >=100 examples per task; benchmark and human eval scores must agree within 8 percentage points; run contamination check before reporting any number
capabilities.when_to_use: After every student fine-tuning checkpoint; multi-benchmark reduces gaming risk; triggers escalation if contamination detected or human eval diverges from benchmark

capabilities.method: Run distillation training loop: AdamW optimizer with cosine LR schedule; gradient clipping (log norm, trigger <5% of steps); checkpoint selection by validation loss not training loss; early stopping when validation loss plateaus; maintain train/val split on distillation dataset
capabilities.when_to_use: After distillation data pipeline produces cached labels; requires separate validation split; revisit on dataset update or student architecture change

decision_procedure: 1. CLASSIFY NEED: Is the query about (a) document ingestion/chunking pipeline OR (b) distillation/dense-representation/model-compression/routing? Both subdomains may apply.

2. FOR INGESTION PATH: Start with DOC_SOURCE_PLAN (enumerate formats/sources). Route PDF to PDF_EXTRACT→LAYOUT_DETECT; tables to TABLE_EXTRACT; figures to FIGURE_HANDLE. Select chunking strategy via CHUNK_STRATEGY before implementing FIXED_CHUNK, SEM_CHUNK, or HIER_CHUNK. Always run DEDUP→PROV_CAPTURE→SHARD_JSONL in that order.

3. FOR DISTILLATION PATH: Verify KD_THEORY foundation, then TEACHER_SELECTION (license check blocks all else). Proceed to STUDENT_ARCH→DISTILL_OBJECTIVE→DATA_PIPELINE→FINETUNING_LOOP. Run BENCHMARK_EVAL+GOODHART_MONITOR after every checkpoint.

4. FOR DENSE KB PATH: JSON_SCHEMA_DESIGN must precede CHUNK_DISTILL. CONSTRAINED_DECODING applied to all LLM JSON generation. LOSSLESSNESS_CHECK runs after every distillation batch. COMPRESSION_RATIO tracks token efficiency. DENSE_RENDERER builds consumer-facing output. SCHEMA_VERSIONING gates any schema change.
5. FOR DEPLOYMENT PATH: SPECIALIST_SCOPE before ROUTING_LOGIC. ORCH_LATENCY modeled before topology finalized. ROUTING_LOGIC requires confidence thresholds and audit log.

6. ESCALATION CHECK: At each node, check human_review_required flag. Nodes DOC_SOURCE_PLAN, PDF_EXTRACT, LAYOUT_DETECT, CHUNK_STRATEGY, KD_THEORY, CHUNK_DISTILL, CONSTRAINED_DECODING, LOSSLESSNESS_CHECK, TEACHER_SELECTION, BENCHMARK_EVAL, SPECIALIST_SCOPE, GOODHART_MONITOR require human review before finalization.

7. CONFLICT RESOLUTION: Apply dominance rules from conflicts_and_dominance when tradeoffs arise. Losslessness dominates compression ratio. License compliance blocks capability selection. Provenance capture is non-negotiable.
8. VALIDATION: Check acceptance tests for each node before handoff. Nodes with handoff_artifact_required=true must produce artifact before downstream nodes proceed.

workflow.objective: Define document universe, formats, sources, and volumes before any extraction code runs
gates: all source systems enumerated with format distributions

workflow.objective: Extract clean text with reading order, structure, tables, and figure metadata from all source formats
exit: empty-string outputs flagged with error codes
gates: TABLE_EXTRACT cell content validated on fixture

workflow.objective: Segment extracted text into retrieval-ready chunks with provenance; eliminate duplicates
entry: clean text with structure labels available

workflow.objective: Serialize chunks to JSONL shards; validate embedding readiness; enable incremental ingestion
gates: EMBED_READY gate: no oversized chunks, no missing metadata

workflow.objective: Establish KD theory basis, select compliant teacher, size student architecture
entry: candidate teacher list with ToS docs
exit: teacher selected with license compliance memo
gates: TEACHER_SELECTION license/ToS review completed before any distillation run

workflow.objective: Generate soft labels, design loss, run training loop, produce trained student checkpoint
exit: cached soft label dataset versioned by teacher checkpoint hash
gates: PROMPT_DISTILL human review of 50 CoT traces if used

workflow.objective: Distill source chunks into dense schema-valid JSON records with losslessness enforcement
Build human-readable rendering layer; establish schema version control
exit: all schema fields appear in rendered output
gates: DENSE_RENDERER human readability review on 20-record sample

workflow.objective: Benchmark distilled student; monitor Goodhart gaming and contamination; validate specialist scope
exit: benchmark and human eval agree within 8pts
gates: contamination scan mandatory before any number reported

workflow.objective: Deploy specialist LLMs with routing, scope enforcement, latency modeling, and audit logging
exit: p95 latency within SLA on load test
gates: ORCH_LATENCY parallel vs serial topology verified

escalation_triggers.condition: DOC_SOURCE_PLAN: new data source onboarded or format distribution shifts >15%
escalation_triggers.reason: Source plan is high cross-topic-coupling (0.82); changes propagate through entire extraction and chunking pipeline

escalation_triggers.condition: PDF_EXTRACT: OCR error rate spike; new PDF encoding class discovered; scanned-page WER >5%
escalation_triggers.reason: Silent OCR failures produce empty-string outputs that propagate undetected; high failure rate (0.28)

escalation_triggers.condition: LAYOUT_DETECT: element misclassification rate >10%; new document domain onboarded; ML layout model version upgrade
escalation_triggers.reason: Layout model overfits to training document styles; cross-domain failure causes header/footer bleed into chunk body

escalation_triggers.condition: CHUNK_STRATEGY: embedding model swapped; retrieval recall degrades >5%; new document length distribution
escalation_triggers.reason: Chunk strategy is highest-leverage and highest-irreversibility decision; wrong strategy requires full re-embed at scale

escalation_triggers.condition: TEACHER_SELECTION: teacher ToS/license unreviewed or ToS updated; selected teacher lacks domain benchmark advantage >=10pts
escalation_triggers.reason: License violation blocks production deployment; highest irreversibility node (0.72) in distillation path

escalation_triggers.condition: KD_THEORY: teacher architecture changes; distillation objective does not include temperature sweep; student loss on soft targets not confirmed lower than hard-label baseline
escalation_triggers.reason: Foundational node—errors here propagate to all downstream distillation quality

escalation_triggers.condition: CHUNK_DISTILL: named entities from source missing in JSON output; null fields where source provides values; schema validation failures
escalation_triggers.reason: Silent information loss at scale; entity recall <0.95 indicates systematic distillation failure

escalation_triggers.condition: CONSTRAINED_DECODING: FSM compilation exceeds 30s; parse failure rate >0%; tokenizer version mismatch
escalation_triggers.reason: Large/recursive schemas cause FSM state explosion; tokenizer mismatch produces invalid token masks

escalation_triggers.condition: LOSSLESSNESS_CHECK: entity recall <0.95; numeric preservation <0.99; caveat retention <0.90
escalation_triggers.reason: Below-threshold fidelity means distilled KB is not safe for downstream use; triggers re-distillation

escalation_triggers.condition: BENCHMARK_EVAL: contamination detected in training data; benchmark and human eval diverge by >8pts; student does not outperform teacher on any benchmark
escalation_triggers.reason: Contamination invalidates reported numbers; divergence indicates Goodhart gaming

escalation_triggers.condition: GOODHART_MONITOR: benchmark improves but human eval does not; no private canary test set maintained; contamination scan not run before reporting
escalation_triggers.reason: Goodhart's Law violation means metric no longer measures real utility; contamination inflates reported numbers

escalation_triggers.condition: SPECIALIST_SCOPE: specialist does not outperform generalist by >=10pts in scope; out-of-scope detector precision <0.90; production query distribution shifts
escalation_triggers.reason: Deploying specialist without confirmed advantage wastes cost and may degrade quality vs generalist fallback

escalation_triggers.condition: ROUTING_LOGIC: fallback rate >15%; routing audit log not capturing confidence scores; new specialist added without threshold recalibration
escalation_triggers.reason: High fallback rate indicates scope-boundary or classifier calibration failure; missing audit log makes debugging impossible

validation_checklist: DOC_SOURCE_PLAN: all source systems enumerated with format distributions; volume estimates within 20% of actual
PDF_EXTRACT: extracted text WER <5% vs manual sample on scanned pages; reading order verified on multi-column fixture; no empty-string outputs without error flag
LAYOUT_DETECT: element classification F1 >0.85 on held-out fixture; headers/footers excluded from chunk text
TABLE_EXTRACT: cell content matches manual extraction on representative fixture; merged cells reconstructed without duplication
FIGURE_HANDLE: caption-figure association correct on fixture; alt-text generation pipeline toggleable without breaking downstream
CHUNK_STRATEGY: strategy rationale documented with embedding model context window and retrieval SLA as inputs
FIXED_CHUNK: no chunk exceeds token limit; overlap spans contiguous with adjacent chunks; all chunks have doc_id and position metadata
SEM_CHUNK: chunk size distribution within [min_tokens, max_tokens] for >95% of chunks; intra-chunk semantic coherence above threshold
HIER_CHUNK: parent-child links validated bidirectionally; child chunks within embedding model context window
DEDUP: deduplication pass confirms <0.1% duplicate examples in training split (mirrors DATA_PIPELINE gate)
PROV_CAPTURE: every chunk has source_doc_id, page_range, byte_offset, extraction_tool_version, chunking_strategy fields
KD_THEORY: temperature sweep over {1,2,4,8,16} documented with chosen T rationale; student soft-target loss lower than hard-label baseline on held-out set
TEACHER_SELECTION: license/ToS review completed and documented before any distillation run; teacher domain benchmark >=10pts above student baseline
STUDENT_ARCH: student latency meets serving SLA on benchmark; student accuracy post-distillation within 5% of teacher on target task
DISTILL_OBJECTIVE: ablation confirms soft-target loss component improves over hard-label-only baseline; temperature chosen with sweep
DATA_PIPELINE: label cache versioned and tied to teacher model checkpoint hash; deduplication confirms <0.1% duplicate examples
FINETUNING_LOOP: validation loss curve shows convergence before checkpoint selection; gradient norm clipping triggered <5% of steps; checkpoint selected by validation loss not training loss
JSON_SCHEMA_DESIGN: schema passes JSON Schema 2020-12 validator; 50 sampled distilled records fully validate against schema; schema includes version field and migration notes
CONSTRAINED_DECODING: parse failure rate = 0% on 1000-record sample; FSM compilation completes in under 30s; outputs satisfy JSON Schema validation on all test inputs
CHUNK_DISTILL: round-trip fidelity—all named entities in source appear in JSON; no empty or null fields where source provides values; schema validation passes on 100% of chunks
LOSSLESSNESS_CHECK: entity recall >=0.95 on test set; numeric fact preservation rate >=0.99; caveat/negation retention rate >=0.90
COMPRESSION_RATIO: compression ratio >=3:1 on test corpus while maintaining entity recall >=0.95; tradeoff curve plotted and reviewed
DENSE_RENDERER: rendered output passes human readability review on 20-record sample; all required schema fields appear in rendered output; rendering roundtrip recovers >=90% of fields
SCHEMA_VERSIONING: all schema changes increment version field; migration script tested on 1000 production records before deployment; rollback to prior schema version tested
PROMPT_DISTILL: human review of 50 sampled CoT traces for correctness before training; student reasoning accuracy on trace-verified test set >=teacher accuracy - 5%
BENCHMARK_EVAL: contamination scan run before reporting any benchmark number; held-out human eval on >=100 examples per task; benchmark and human eval agree within 8 percentage points
GOODHART_MONITOR: contamination scan on training corpus before benchmark reporting; human eval Pearson correlation >=0.75 with benchmark; private canary benchmark maintained and not shared publicly
SPECIALIST_SCOPE: specialist outperforms generalist by >=10pts within defined scope; out-of-scope detector precision >=0.90 on boundary test set
ROUTING_LOGIC: routing audit log captures every dispatch with confidence score; fallback rate <15% on production traffic sample; end-to-end accuracy with routing >=specialist in-scope accuracy
ORCH_LATENCY: end-to-end latency p95 within SLA on load test; cost-per-query projection within budget at target QPS

conflicts_and_dominance.resolution: Losslessness dominates: entity recall >=0.95, numeric preservation >=0.99, caveat retention >=0.90 are hard floors; compression target is secondary and may be relaxed to meet losslessness floor

License/ToS compliance dominates: a higher-capability teacher that is ToS-restricted for distillation must be replaced by an open-weight alternative even at capability cost; no distillation run starts with unresolved license status

Retrieval quality dominates when MRR improvement justifies cost; semantic chunking preferred over fixed-size when downstream use is RAG and token budget allows; fixed-size acceptable as baseline or when latency is the primary constraint
Constrained decoding dominates: schemas with recursive references that cause FSM explosion must be simplified even if expressiveness is reduced; parse failure rate = 0% is non-negotiable

Human eval utility dominates when divergence >8pts: benchmark scores must not be reported without contamination scan; Goodhart monitoring runs continuously; private canary benchmark maintained independently

Explicit scope boundary dominates: specialist must be deployed with out-of-scope detector and generalist fallback; deploying specialist without fallback is blocked; fallback rate >15% triggers scope re-definition

Logit distillation (KL divergence on soft targets) dominates when teacher logits are accessible; CoT distillation is fallback-only when teacher is API-accessible without logit export; CoT introduces hallucination risk requiring mandatory human trace review

Hierarchical chunking dominates for long-form documents with section structure when both retrieval precision and generation context are required; fixed chunking acceptable for short documents or when layout detection is unavailable

Parallel specialist calls dominate when call dependencies permit: parallel adds max(latencies) vs serial adds sum(latencies); cold-start latency must be included in both models; SLA budget determines maximum chain depth

glossary.definition: contiguous text span derived from a source document, annotated with position and provenance metadata, ready for embedding; not same as document or sentence
correct sequential order of text blocks in a document accounting for multi-column layouts and sidebars; not same as byte offset order
metadata recording origin, extraction context, transformation history, teacher model version, prompt template hash, schema version, and distillation timestamp of a chunk or distilled record
one file partition in a set of JSONL files containing an approximately equal subset of chunks for parallel processing
two chunks with token Jaccard similarity above threshold but not identical, arising from boilerplate repetition; not same as exact duplicate
chunk in a parent-child hierarchy where child chunks are fine-grained and parent chunks provide section-level context; linked bidirectionally
point in text where topic or theme shifts, detected via embedding cosine-similarity drop; not same as sentence boundary or fixed token boundary
identifier linking an ingested chunk to a structured knowledge base node for citation and retrieval traceability
fraction of source documents that produce non-empty extracted text; key pipeline health metric
information encoded in teacher soft output probability distributions over all classes; inter-class similarity absent from hard one-hot labels; basis of Hinton/Vinyals/Dean 2015 KD framework
division of logits by temperature T before softmax; high T produces softer distributions revealing more inter-class information; T=4 robust for classification, T=8 for generation tasks

generation method masking invalid tokens at each step using FSM compiled from target grammar or JSON schema over tokenizer vocabulary; guarantees structural validity without post-hoc repair; implemented via Outlines (Willard & Louf 2023)

property of distillation ensuring all semantically load-bearing facts in source are recoverable from dense representation; measured by entity recall, numeric preservation rate, caveat retention rate; not same as compression ratio
ratio of source token count to distilled JSON token count; target >=3:1 while maintaining losslessness floor

when a measure becomes a target it ceases to be a good measure; in LLM context: benchmark optimization without real utility improvement; mitigated via private canary benchmarks and human eval correlation
distilled LLM trained on narrow task domain that outperforms generalist of comparable or larger size within that domain; requires explicit scope boundary and out-of-scope fallback

knowledge transfer via chain-of-thought reasoning traces extracted from teacher rather than logit distributions; fallback when teacher API does not expose logits; introduces hallucination risk requiring human trace review

process of compiling JSON Schema or regex grammar into finite-state machine over model tokenizer vocabulary for constrained decoding; must complete in <30s; recursive schemas may cause state explosion
combined term: temperature T in KD controls how soft/peaked the teacher distribution is; low T approaches hard labels; high T reveals inter-class structure (dark knowledge)

How is document layout structure detected and which elements should be excluded from chunk body text?
How should tables and figures be handled to preserve relational and visual information in the ingestion pipeline?
What chunking strategy should be selected given a specific embedding model context window and retrieval SLA, and how do the tradeoffs between fixed, semantic, and hierarchical chunking compare?
How is semantic chunking implemented and what guardrails prevent oversized or trivially small chunks?
How are near-duplicate chunks detected and removed while preserving canonical instances with full provenance?
What provenance fields must every chunk carry and how are they used for downstream citation traceability?
What theoretical basis justifies training a student model on teacher soft outputs rather than hard labels?
How is the distillation loss designed and what temperature schedule controls gradient informativeness?
How is each source chunk distilled into a dense JSON record and what schema governs the output?
How is guaranteed-valid JSON output achieved without post-hoc repair during LLM-based distillation?
How is schema evolved over time without breaking existing consumers or distilled record stores?
How are dense JSON records rendered into human-readable form for downstream consumers?
How is losslessness of distillation measured and enforced across entity, numeric, and caveat retention?
